item.text: The Corruption and Crime Commission investigated allegations about a senior police officer's disclosure of confidential information and use of police vehicles.
item.support: Operation Pemaquid focussed on two matters of potential misconduct: the release of confidential information; and the misuse of police motor vehicles.

item.text: The Commission formed opinions of police misconduct concerning the officer's vehicle use and repeated disclosure of confidential information.
item.support: The Commission has formed an opinion of police misconduct on two matters:

item.text: The Commission emphasised that its misconduct opinion did not establish guilt of a criminal or disciplinary offence.
item.support: An opinion that misconduct has occurred is not to be taken as a finding or opinion that a particular person is guilty

item.text: The Commission made two recommendations: review the vehicle commuting policy and regularly remind staff about confidentiality.
item.support: WA Police gives periodic reminders that stress the importance of confidentiality.
